## 🚀 Next Steps for User

### 1. Configure Secrets in GitHub (REQUIRED)

Go to GitHub → **Settings** → **Secrets and variables** → **Actions** and add:

```
Secret Name: WINDOWS_CERTIFICATE
Value: [entire content of certificates/certificate-base64.txt]

Secret Name: WINDOWS_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD
Value: apuntador2024!
```

### 2. Run Test Build

Once the secrets are configured, any push to the main branch will automatically execute a signed build.

### 3. Verify Result

- Download the MSI generated by GitHub Actions
- Install it on Windows
- Verify there are fewer Windows Defender warnings

## 🔧 Quick Reference Commands

```powershell
# Regenerate certificate if needed
.\scripts\create-self-signed-cert.ps1

# Verify certificate in Windows store
Get-ChildItem Cert:\CurrentUser\My | Where-Object {$_.Subject -like "*Apuntador*"}

# Clean old certificates (if needed)
Get-ChildItem Cert:\CurrentUser\My | Where-Object {$_.Subject -like "*Apuntador*"} | Remove-Item
```
